---
title: "Glossary"
as_of: "2026-09-07"
---

**Low Altitude Economy, LAE (低空经济)**  
Hong Kong working definition: economic activity generally below 1,000 metres (LegCo CB(3)933/2024). Mainland statistical definition: NDRC 发改低空〔2025〕1676号 (22 December 2025). Week 1.

**Regulatory Sandbox (监管沙盒)**  
First-cohort Hong Kong trial programme. Applications from 13 November 2024; 38 of 72 proposals selected (TLB/GIA, 20 March 2025). BVLOS in this programme is covered by CAD AC-013. Week 1 / Week 7.

**Regulatory Sandbox X (监管沙盒X)**  
Advanced programme launched 24 November 2025. Separate from the first Sandbox. Module batches reported as UTM 15, unconventional aircraft 4, shared platform 5, others 9; cross-boundary results still open. CAD AC-017 covers cross-boundary operations in Sandbox X. Week 1 / Week 7.

**Small Unmanned Aircraft Order, Cap. 448G (小型无人驾驶飞机令)**  
Hong Kong statute for small unmanned aircraft. Full effect 1 December 2022; Category C up to 150 kg from 18 July 2025. Week 7.

**Civil Aviation Department, CAD (民航处)**  
Hong Kong regulator under Cap. 448G and issuer of the sandbox Advisory Circulars. Week 1 / Week 7.

**Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy (发展低空经济工作组)**  
Cross-government group headed by the Deputy Financial Secretary; first meeting 12 November 2024. Week 1.

**UAS (Private) Licence, 1430–1444 MHz**  
Dedicated unmanned-aircraft spectrum, confined to LAE Regulatory Sandbox projects, from 27 October 2025 (CA/OFCA). Week 7.

**Beyond Visual Line of Sight, BVLOS**  
Operation beyond the remote pilot’s sight. In the first Sandbox, the relevant circular is CAD AC-013. Week 7.

**Civil Aviation Law of the PRC, 2025 revision (中华人民共和国民用航空法)**  
Passed 27 December 2025; Order No. 65; effective 1 July 2026. Unmanned-aircraft operating rules remain under State Council instruments (国令761 and CCAR-92, both effective 1 January 2024) until further rules are made. Week 7.

**Industry value-added (产业增加值)**  
Accounting concept used by Our Hong Kong Foundation for the ~HK$350 billion figure: Hong Kong only, horizon 2050, September 2025 report. Not government output and not a Mainland 规模 total. Week 1 / Week 9.

**CAAC ATM Rules (draft) / 《民用航空空中交通管理规则（征求意见稿）》**  
NEW watch term. Published **2026-08-11**; comments to **2026-09-11**; Chapter 12 无人驾驶航空器. Not yet law. (WEEKLY-2026-09-05)

**HKCA 1072**  
Do **not** map to the 1.4 GHz UAS (Private) Licence (GN-1/2025). HKCA 1072 Iss.2 (Aug 2026) is E-UTRA base station — different instrument. (WEEKLY-2026-09-05)

**Value chain (价值链)**  
Stages from vehicle and infrastructure to operations and supporting services. Course. Week 1.

**Supporting services**  
The segment that accounts for most of the 2050 value-added projection. OHKF. Week 1.

**Economies of density**  
Average cost falls as flights share the same corridor or vertiport. Course. Week 2.

**HHI**  
Sum of squared shares; classroom calculations stay off this site. Course. Week 2.

**CASK / CPMK**  
Cost per available seat-km or per available payload-km. Lecture numbers are not data. Course. Week 3.

**CAPEX / OPEX**  
Upfront assets versus recurring operating cost. Course. Week 3.

**Generalised cost**  
Money plus time valued at the passenger’s value of time. Course. Week 4.

**NASA UAM market study constraints**  
Legal, weather, infrastructure and acceptance shrink the unconstrained market. NASA 2018. Week 4.

**Vertiport**  
2025 Policy Address names planning of take-off and landing sites. Hong Kong has no dedicated statutory definition yet (OPEN). 2025 PA. Week 5.

**Throughput**  
Movements a site can handle per hour after safety separation. Course. Week 5.

**FaaS / platform model**  
Fly-as-a-service or matching, as distinct from owning the fleet. Course. Week 6.

**LAE insurance task force**  
Industry group using Sandbox data. 2025 PA ¶157. Week 6.

**Advanced operations**  
Operations that need prior CAD permission. Cap. 448G / CAD. Week 7.

**Unconventional aircraft**  
Intended dedicated rules for craft over 150 kg; legislation OPEN. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 7.

**UTM**  
Smart low-altitude traffic-management system, planned infrastructure, not yet a Hong Kong statute. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 8.

**Airspace classification G / W**  
Mainland national classification (2023); do not treat as Hong Kong law. Mainland national classification. Week 8.

**Unconstrained versus constrained market**  
Theoretical demand versus demand after barriers. NASA study. Week 9.

**规模 versus value-added**  
Mainland scale totals are not the same metric as OHKF industry value-added. Course / OHKF contrast. Week 9.

**Externality**  
Noise, risk, or carbon not priced in the ticket. Course. Week 10.

**Pigovian instrument**  
Tax, charge or subsidy aimed at that externality; Hong Kong has no drone congestion tax in force. Course. Week 10.

**Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy**  
2025 PA ¶154; text OPEN. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 11–12.

**Interoperability / standards**  
Ability of vehicles, UTM and sites to work to a common rule set; cite PA infrastructure language only. Course / 2025 PA. Week 11–12.
